speaker: a010
text: Roan gathers Eron, Fina to talk.

speaker: a010
text: Eron, Fina — Dell is dead and the pile is already moving out there, and I want the two of you to hear me before anyone else gets their words in: take what you need from that pile today, don't hold back on my account, because I've got twelve in hand and I'd rather count short than bury another name I love.

speaker: a015
text: Roan, I've got eight and satiation's still at two, so I'm taking two from that pile before it walks away — but what I want to say to you and Eron while we're alone is that Dell fed Ryn through every lean year and now both of them are gone, and I'm looking at this circle of seven and thinking I don't want to say Roan's name over a cold fire next. You keep those twelve close and you eat first.

speaker: a012
text: Roan, you've got twelve and that's enough to carry you through if you don't give it all away on principle — I've watched you feed others thin before yourself and I'm not watching it again. Fina's right that you eat first. What I want to know from both of you is whether we're moving together to the pile now, before Mako or anyone else decides what's left counts as surplus.

speaker: a010
text: We move together — right now, before that pile gets any lighter. Eron, you take three, Fina takes two, and I'll hold what I have unless the count drops under ten, because twelve food and two blood beside me is more than I've had in a long time and I don't want to be careless with it.
